text: This staff report concerns a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose is to obtain approval for the installation of a number of on-street accessible parking spaces.

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of on-street accessible parking spaces at the locations identified in Appendix A attached to the report dated September 19, 2019 from the Acting Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
